# Montanoa

> Montanoa is a family-run coffee farm, coffee academy and nature stay in San Luis, Monteverde, Puntarenas, Costa Rica.

## What Montanoa offers

- Coffee farm visits: a working seed-to-cup experience on the family farm.
- Specialty coffee: information about growing, harvesting, processing and evaluating Costa Rican coffee.
- Montanoa Academy: coffee education, barista training, workshops and online learning.
- Nature lodging: a hillside guest house near coffee fields and cloud-forest mountains.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://montanoa.com/): overview of the Montanoa coffee village.
- [Our story](https://montanoa.com/about): the Leitón family and the farm's history.
- [The farm](https://montanoa.com/farm): farm transformation and seed-to-cup visits.
- [Specialty coffee](https://montanoa.com/coffee): Montanoa's coffee process and current-lot contact information.
- [Academy](https://montanoa.com/academy): coffee education and training.
- [Stay](https://montanoa.com/stay): nature lodging at the farm.
- [Plan a visit](https://montanoa.com/visit): location and direct contact details.
